newsitem.title: INDIA: Prudential ties up with India's ICICI - paper.
newsitem.headline: Prudential ties up with India's ICICI - paper.

text.p: Prudential Corp, Britain's largest insurance company, has tied up with Industrial Credit and Investment Corp of India (ICICI) for a joint-venture to enter the life insurance business once the sector opens up, the Economic Times newspaper said on Friday.
Prudential has scheduled a press conference in Bombay on Monday to formally announce a new joint venture in India, but has not said who its partner will be.
The newspaper said the tie-up involves an agreement to form a 50-50 joint venture once the government opens up the life-sector of the insurance market.

The partners have no plans to tap the health insurance sector, which Finance Minister P.Chidambaram said should be thrown open in his 1997/98 budget proposals, which will be debated in parliament next week.
ICICI is also looking for a partner to enter the non-life sector, the report said.
Prudential has sought clearance for a holding company, Prudential Corp India Pvt Ltd, through which it will route its investments into India.
